scope: all tracked source, skills, documents and retained evidence at closeout start; ignored installed dependencies/state excluded
review_limits: Complete byte reads and text/structure/static review across all files; active instructions received semantic review.
Large third-party payload/playbook corpus: full-content static scanning, not asserted line-by-line human semantic proof.
Binary JAR/ZIP: bytes, identities and archive structure; not textual semantic reading.
Evidence snapshots retain original absolute paths/statuses and are not executable current configuration.
